comment: The knob labelled DECAY on the panel is configured as "Sustain" in the code (Glass.cpp:269) and controls how long a bowl rings after its gate drops. The pitch input is folded into a three-octave window and snapped to the nearest of thirty-seven fixed bowl pitches (Glass.cpp:221), so it does not track a keyboard continuously; ROOT and FM move the whole set. The module skips almost all of its work while no bowl holds energy (Glass.cpp:557).
